pages.text: $(l)Use unfinished notes on the research desk.$() Place ink beside the paper or keep it in your pack; the desk takes what it needs when you begin.$(br2)Choose a shape on the right and fit it into a slot of the same color. Left-click a node to adjust its values, or right-click a loose end to lift it away. The shapes on the paper are impressions: your actual gems stay in your pack.

pages.title: A Fresh Page
pages.text: View the Reference to compare connections and hover to inspect values, then return to My Reading.$(br2)$(l)Leaving unfinished work returns the notes and clears the draft and ink payment.$() A fresh attempt needs fresh ink. Knowledge already understood remains yours.
